name: 分组管理
desc: 新建分组（空输入禁用、计数归零）、切换分组与任务归属、行内菜单改名（预填原名、同步任务元信息）、删除需二次确认且组内任务移入默认、默认分组删除置灰、刷新后持久化

steps.eval: if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.wipe = async () => { const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app'); const K = '__todo_test_backup_v1'; if (localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_dirty') === '1') { const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K) || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } } const snap = { todos: await s.getItem('todos'), groups: await s.getItem('groups'), ui: await s.getItem('ui') }; localStorage.setItem(K, JSON.stringify(snap)); localStorage.setItem('__todo_test_dirty', '1'); await s.removeItem('todos'); await s.removeItem('groups'); await s.removeItem('ui'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'wiped, backup todos=' + (snap.todos ? snap.todos.length : 0); }; return await T.wipe();

if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.q = (s) => { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); const r = p && p.shadowRoot; return r ? Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s)) : []; }; T.ready = async (sel, ms) => { const n = Math.ceil((ms || 3000) / 100); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (T.q(sel).length) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } throw new Error('页面就绪超时，找不到 ' + sel); }; T.tx = (el) => el.textContent.trim(); T.click = (el) => { if (!el) throw new Error('元素不存在'); const b = el.shadowRoot && el.shadowRoot.querySelector('button'); (b || el).click(); return true; }; T.byText = (sel, t) => T.q(sel).find((e) => T.tx(e) === t) || null; T.btn = (t) => T.click(T.byText('st-button', t)); T.dlg = () => T.q('st-dialog').find((d) => d.hasAttribute('open')) || null; T.dlgBtn = (t) => { const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('当前没有打开的弹窗'); return T.click(Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((b) => T.tx(b) === t)); }; T.dlgHead = () => T.tx(T.dlg().querySelector('[slot=headline]')); T.wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms || 300)); T.items = () => T.q('.item'); T.need = (t) => { const i = T.items().find((x) => T.tx(x.querySelector('.text')) === t); if (!i) throw new Error('找不到任务：' + t); return i; }; T.setVal = (el, v) => { if (!el) throw new Error('输入元素不存在'); el.value = v; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return true; }; T.NL = String.fromCharCode(10); T.rownames = () => T.q('.gitem .gname').map((n) => T.tx(n)); T.gcount = (name) => { const g = T.q('.gitem').find((x) => T.tx(x.querySelector('.gname')) === name); if (!g) throw new Error('找不到分组：' + name); return T.tx(g.querySelector('.gcount')); }; T.addTask = async (title, desc) => { T.btn('添加任务'); await T.wait(350); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('添加弹窗未打开'); T.setVal(d.querySelector('.dialog-field'), desc ? title + T.NL + desc : title); await T.wait(250); T.dlgBtn('添加'); await T.wait(400); return true; }; T.pickGroup = (name) => { const g = T.q('.gitem').find((x) => T.tx(x.querySelector('.gname')) === name); if (!g) throw new Error('找不到分组：' + name); g.querySelector('.gname').click(); return true; }; T.groupAction = async (name, label) => { const g = T.q('.gitem').find((x) => T.tx(x.querySelector('.gname')) === name); if (!g) throw new Error('找不到分组：' + name); T.click(g.querySelector('st-menu st-icon-button')); await T.wait(); const mi = Array.from(g.querySelectorAll('st-menu-item')).find((m) => T.tx(m) === label); if (!mi) throw new Error('菜单里找不到：' + label); T.click(mi); await T.wait(); return true; }; return 'helpers ready';

await T.ready('.add-group-btn'); if (T.rownames().join(',') !== '全部任务,默认') throw new Error('初始分组不正确：' + T.rownames()); T.btn('新建分组'); await T.wait(350); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('「新建分组」应打开弹窗'); if (T.dlgHead() !== '新建分组') throw new Error('弹窗标题不正确：' + T.dlgHead()); const create = Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((b) => T.tx(b) === '创建'); if (!create.hasAttribute('disabled')) throw new Error('空输入时「创建」应禁用'); T.dlgBtn('取消'); await T.wait(350); if (T.rownames().join(',') !== '全部任务,默认') throw new Error('取消后不应新增分组：' + T.rownames()); return 'ok';

T.btn('新建分组'); await T.wait(350); T.setVal(T.dlg().querySelector('.dialog-input'), '工作'); await T.wait(300); const create = Array.from(T.dlg().querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((b) => T.tx(b) === '创建'); if (create.hasAttribute('disabled')) throw new Error('输入名字后「创建」应可用'); T.dlgBtn('创建'); await T.wait(450); if (T.dlg()) throw new Error('创建后弹窗应关闭'); if (T.rownames().join(',') !== '全部任务,默认,工作') throw new Error('侧栏应出现新分组：' + T.rownames()); if (T.gcount('工作') !== '0 项') throw new Error('新分组计数应为 0 项，实际 ' + T.gcount('工作')); return 'ok';

T.pickGroup('工作'); await T.wait(350); const active = T.q('.gitem.active .gname').map((n) => T.tx(n)).join(','); if (active !== '工作') throw new Error('应选中「工作」分组：' + active); T.btn('添加任务'); await T.wait(350); if (T.dlg().textContent.indexOf('将加入分组：「工作」') === -1) throw new Error('添加弹窗应提示归属分组'); T.dlgBtn('取消'); await T.wait(300); await T.addTask('写周报', '本周总结'); const meta = T.tx(T.need('写周报').querySelector('.meta')); if (meta.indexOf('工作 · 创建于') !== 0) throw new Error('分组内新增任务应归入该分组：' + meta); if (T.gcount('工作') !== '1 项') throw new Error('分组计数不正确：' + T.gcount('工作')); if (T.gcount('全部任务') !== '1 项') throw new Error('「全部任务」计数不正确：' + T.gcount('全部任务')); return 'ok';

T.pickGroup('全部任务'); await T.wait(350); await T.addTask('买牛奶', ''); const meta = T.tx(T.need('买牛奶').querySelector('.meta')); if (meta.indexOf('默认 · 创建于') !== 0) throw new Error('「全部任务」下新增应归默认分组：' + meta); return 'ok';

await T.groupAction('工作', '重命名'); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('菜单「重命名」应打开弹窗'); if (T.dlgHead() !== '改名分组：「工作」') throw new Error('改名弹窗标题不正确：' + T.dlgHead()); if (d.querySelector('.dialog-input').value !== '工作') throw new Error('改名弹窗应预填原名'); T.setVal(d.querySelector('.dialog-input'), '工作区'); await T.wait(300); T.dlgBtn('保存'); await T.wait(450); if (T.rownames().join(',') !== '全部任务,默认,工作区') throw new Error('改名未同步到侧栏：' + T.rownames()); if (T.tx(T.need('写周报').querySelector('.meta')).indexOf('工作区 · ') !== 0) throw new Error('改名未同步到任务副标题'); return 'ok';
await T.groupAction('默认', '删除'); await T.wait(450); if (T.dlg()) throw new Error('默认分组的「删除」应置灰，不应弹出确认框'); return 'ok';

await T.groupAction('工作区', '删除'); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('删除分组应弹二次确认'); if (T.dlgHead() !== '删除分组「工作区」？') throw new Error('确认框标题不正确：' + T.dlgHead()); if (d.textContent.indexOf('1 项任务会移入') === -1) throw new Error('确认框应说明任务去向：' + d.textContent); T.dlgBtn('取消'); await T.wait(450); if (T.dlg()) throw new Error('取消后确认框应关闭'); if (T.rownames().join(',') !== '全部任务,默认,工作区') throw new Error('取消后分组应保留：' + T.rownames()); return 'ok';

T.pickGroup('工作区'); await T.wait(350); await T.groupAction('工作区', '删除'); await T.wait(350); T.dlgBtn('确认'); await T.wait(550); if (T.rownames().join(',') !== '全部任务,默认') throw new Error('分组应被删除：' + T.rownames()); const active = T.q('.gitem.active .gname').map((n) => T.tx(n)).join(','); if (active !== '全部任务') throw new Error('删除当前分组后应回落到「全部任务」：' + active); if (T.tx(T.need('写周报').querySelector('.meta')).indexOf('默认 · ') !== 0) throw new Error('组内任务应移入默认分组'); if (T.items().length !== 2) throw new Error('任务不应随分组删除而消失：' + T.items().length); return 'ok';

let root = null; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); root = p && p.shadowRoot; if (root && root.querySelector('.shell')) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } if (!root || !root.querySelector('.shell')) throw new Error('刷新后页面未就绪'); const names = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.gitem .gname')).map((n) => n.textContent.trim()); if (names.join(',') !== '全部任务,默认') throw new Error('刷新后分组不正确：' + names); const items = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.item')); if (items.length !== 2) throw new Error('刷新后列表应有 2 条，实际 ' + items.length); const target = items.find((i) => i.querySelector('.text').textContent.trim() === '写周报'); if (!target) throw new Error('刷新后找不到 写周报'); const meta = target.querySelector('.meta').textContent.trim(); if (meta.indexOf('默认 · ') !== 0) throw new Error('刷新后归属应仍是默认分组：' + meta); return 'ok';

const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app'); const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_backup_v1') || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } localStorage.removeItem('__todo_test_dirty'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'restored';
